entries.en: 775M→870M (2026-09-30 decision: uniform workload-normalization for measured samples with token breakdown, recomputed as a whole after folding in the third segment 60%→50%): segment worth $13.2824 (cache 52.54M×$0.10 + input 2.74M×$2 + output 0.25M×$10) ÷31%×4 weeks = $171.39 ÷ standard-tier blended price $0.197/MTok; GPT-6.1 Sol official prices $0.10/$2/$10 (learn.chatgpt.com credits 2.5/50/250 ÷25, cached = 5% of input — replacing the 896M that first assumed the 6-Sol $0.2 price; if the 6-Sol price still applied the result would be 814M, kept for comparison); the raw-basis 7.17 is kept for comparison. Doubts (2026-10-01 decision: record first, adopt per the whole segment 81%→50%): the third segment 60%→50% yields $0.330 per 1%, about 30% below the first two segments' $0.476/$0.473, which the 10pp integer-reading rounding (about ±10%) cannot explain — cause unknown. The cache-read price was confirmed on 2026-10-01: GPT-6.1 Sol $0.10, GPT-6 Sol $0.20. Original adoption decision — new 717M: whole segment 55,532,850÷31%×4 weeks (= 81%→65% segment 30,109,568÷16pp + 65%→60% segment 10,562,908÷5pp + 60%→50% segment 14,860,374÷10pp — the three segment boundaries join and the component sums match item by item); panel integer-% readings Δpp 30~32 map to 843M~899M normalized; the screenshot title's 82%/32pp starting reading was corrected to 81%; back-deriving the weekly pool from the 6.1 official credits tier gives 1,071cr ($42.85), while linux.do observes Plus at about 3,426cr/week and the Pro 20x same-pool Sol-worth÷20 is closer to $119.6/week at a 5.6 equivalent rate — a possible difference in in-subscription metering rate or pool basis is recorded as uncertainty; segment densities (6.1 prices): seg1 $0.476/pp, seg2 $0.473/pp, seg3 $0.330/pp; Pro 5x/20x not derived (follows the Sol ruling); no benchmark score yet — a supplement will be added once one exists

entries.zh: 27.62→25.89亿（2026-09-30 裁定带分项实测统一折算，Anthropic 档）：段 worth $733.93（读1,004.96M×$0.5＋1h写12.99M×$10＋入0.01M×$5＋出4.06M×$25）＝每1% $4.96 → 周$495.9×4周 ÷ Anthropic 档混合价$0.76625/MTok；raw 口径 27.62 留作对照。以下为 issue #53 采用决策——18.78→27.62亿，2026-09-30 裁定改用 issue #53：两个 Pro 账号、全部在 9/14 永久 +25% 之后，1,022.02M raw（读1,004.96M/1h写12.99M/入0.01M/出4.06M）＝周 +148 个百分点 → 6.906M/pp ×100 ×4周；两个整周分别 24.60/28.96 亿；按标价每 1% worth $4.96。旧面板样本每 1% $3.67（7% 整数读数，区间 17.53~20.23 亿），高出 35%/47% 与 +25% 调整幅度相近，疑为 9/14 前测得，故不与之合并（合并为 27.22 亿不采）；Anthropic 档 worth 口径 25.89 亿（2026-09-30 起改判为采用，见首行）。张力：与 Max 20x 采用值 157 的比从 8.35× 变为 5.68×，与 Opus 5.5 的 301.7/30.54≈9.9× 不一致，指向 Max 20x 侧口径或 5.5/5 池权重（#52/#53 推约 0.843），待裁定。以下为旧 18.78 决策原文——Opus4.8历史15.88亿→Opus5面板反推18.78亿：32,868,513 total（opus5 32.85M + haiku 23k）÷7%×4周；周池4.70亿、5h池56.7M，周池为绑定约束；周%取整区间约17.5~20.2亿；单会话n=1初定medium；round5候选Opus5约1.9亿（假定周消息数）被面板直测推翻作废；标价闭合校验$25.68吻合；2026-09-21裁定Opus4.8旧测不入权——round8曾按基准期读法×1.25=19.85亿作互证，但round6记录该值含+50%活动期boost，忠实映射为÷1.5×1.25=13.23亿且与面板矛盾，故仅面板单源；round9同作者第二条40M=周13%记为张力：新周读法12.3亿/续周读法26.7亿/下限读法不约束，基线不可考不入权；2026-09-21裁定升high：面板级形式+价格闭合校验+下调后口径+与Max20x周池比8.35×自洽；#3新周读法12.3亿与Max池比将失衡（$20得$100档的相对池份额异常），反证18.78侧。注：曾引'8.28窗/周与Max同构'为旁证，round9检查点反推Max档5h池~7.1亿（非4.74亿满窗读法）后该互证撤回——Max周满窗数~5.5非8.3
entries.en: 2.762B→2.589B (2026-09-30 decision: uniform workload-normalization for measured samples with token breakdown, Anthropic tier): segment worth $733.93 (read 1,004.96M×$0.5 + 1h write 12.99M×$10 + in 0.01M×$5 + out 4.06M×$25) = $4.96 per 1% → $495.9/week ×4 weeks ÷ Anthropic-tier blended price $0.76625/MTok; the raw-basis 27.62 is kept for comparison. The issue #53 adoption decision — 1.878B→2.762B, 2026-09-30 decision switching to issue #53: two Pro accounts, all after the permanent 9/14 +25%: 1,022.02M raw (read 1,004.96M / 1h write 12.99M / in 0.01M / out 4.06M) = +148 weekly percentage points → 6.906M/pp ×100 ×4 weeks; the two full weeks give 2.460B and 2.896B respectively; worth per 1% at list prices is $4.96. The old panel sample gives $3.67 per 1% (7% integer reading, interval 1.753B~2.023B) — 35%/47% higher, close to the +25% adjustment, presumably measured before 9/14, so it is not merged (the merged 2.722B is not adopted); the Anthropic-tier worth basis is 2.589B (ruled adopted from 2026-09-30, see first line). Tension: the ratio to the Max 20x adopted value 157 changes from 8.35× to 5.68×, inconsistent with Opus 5.5's 301.7/30.54≈9.9× — pointing to the Max 20x basis or the 5.5/5 pool weights (#52/#53 derive ≈0.843), pending ruling. Original old 18.78 decision text — Opus 4.8's historical 1.588B → Opus 5 panel back-derivation 1.878B: 32,868,513 total (opus5 32.85M + haiku 23k) ÷7%×4 weeks; weekly pool 470M, 5h pool 56.7M — the weekly pool is the binding constraint; weekly-% rounding interval about 1.75B~2.02B; single session n=1, initially medium; round5's Opus5 candidate ≈190M (assuming weekly message counts) was voided by the direct panel measurement; the list-price closure check $25.68 agrees; 2026-09-21 decision: Opus 4.8's old measurement gets no weight — round8 had used the baseline-period reading ×1.25 = 1.985B as corroboration, but round6 records that value as containing a +50% promo boost; the faithful mapping ÷1.5×1.25 = 1.323B contradicts the panel, so only the panel source stands; round9's second post by the same author, 40M = 13% of the week, is recorded as tension: new-week reading 1.23B / continuing-week reading 2.67B / lower-bound reading non-binding — the baseline is unknowable, not weighted; 2026-09-21 decision raising to high: panel-grade form + price closure check + post-cut basis + self-consistent 8.35× weekly-pool ratio vs Max 20x; #3's new-week reading 1.23B would unbalance the Max pool ratio (a $20 tier getting a $100 tier's relative pool share is abnormal), corroborating the 18.78 side. Note: '8.28 windows/week isomorphic to Max' was once cited as corroboration; after round9 checkpoints back-derived the Max tier's 5h pool at ~710M (not the 474M full-window reading), that corroboration was withdrawn — Max's full windows per week are ~5.5, not 8.3

entries.zh: 4.97→5.72亿（2026-09-30 裁定带分项实测统一折算）：「这次」窗 worth $36.7812（cache 51.73M×$0.5＋入4.62M×$2＋出0.28M×$6）÷45.5475%＝周$80.75 ÷ 标准档混合价$0.565/MTok＝周池 142,926,384；raw 口径 4.97 留作对照。以下为原采用决策——6.72→5.72亿：周池 168,035,200→142,926,384——round2 大窗实测取代 round1 份额推断；三窗反推 176.1M/124.3M/132.1M，裁定「这次」（45.5% 最大消耗窗）最可信；「之前」窗已对上 round1 三会话，删除版实得 628,541 tok/0.36%；对 4.6 折算周池 1.289亿为 1.11× 同量级；两窗反推不重合，池口径或面值有未解变量，n=1 账号维持 medium
entries.en: 497M→572M (2026-09-30 decision: uniform workload-normalization for measured samples with token breakdown): the "this time" window worth $36.7812 (cache 51.73M×$0.5 + in 4.62M×$2 + out 0.28M×$6) ÷45.5475% = $80.75/week ÷ standard-tier blended price $0.565/MTok = weekly pool 142,926,384; the raw-basis 4.97 is kept for comparison. Original adoption decision — 672M→572M: weekly pool 168,035,200→142,926,384 — round2's large-window measurement replaces round1's share inference; three-window back-derivations 176.1M/124.3M/132.1M, and the ruled "this time" (45.5%, the largest-consumption window) most credible; the "earlier" window already matches round1's three sessions, and the deleted version actually got 628,541 tok/0.36%; for 4.6 the normalized weekly pool 128.9M is 1.11× — same magnitude; the two windows' back-derivations do not coincide — unresolved variables in pool basis or face value, n=1 account stays medium

entries.zh: 未折算、暂估：缺M3.1独立公开计价比例，不借用M3价格；有分项样本的临时raw例外，2026-10-01 裁定接受（MiniMax 官方未公布 M3.1 价格，暂不折算）。Go小时累计23,970,451 tok对应周已用4%→10%，5h已用41%→100%；并非0%→100%完整5h窗口。12:00至12:01起点累计未截图，全段以起始小时计数为0、期间无其他共享池消耗为假设，两项未单独确认。周整数显示取整敏感性约13.6974~19.1764亿/月(4周)，不是统计置信区间；中末差分12,201,679 tok/3pp对应16.2689亿/月，仅作对照。全口径cache/input/output约95.1823%/3.4854%/1.3323%，页面96.5%是输入缓存命中率，不等同标准负载缓存占比。按相同负载与饱和使用比较，不是官方固定token额度。月付常规价¥49，由年付实价÷10及官方FAQ还原，不含首月促销。；汇率1 USD=6.7787 CNY（2026-09-04 人民币汇率中间价），旧汇率7.2；人民币月费除以汇率换美元；https://www.xinhuanet.com/20260904/4c1ce1cbf39d416997cb9c237d6f5024/c.html
entries.en: Not workload-normalized, provisional estimate: M3.1 has no independent published pricing ratio, so M3 prices are not borrowed; a temporary raw exception with a component-level sample, accepted by ruling on 2026-10-01 (MiniMax has not published official M3.1 prices, so no normalization for now). Go's hourly cumulative 23,970,451 tok maps to weekly-used 4%→10% and 5h-used 41%→100%; it is not a complete 0%→100% 5-hour window. The 12:00–12:01 starting cumulative was not screenshotted; the whole segment assumes the starting hour count was 0 and that no other shared-pool consumption occurred — neither assumption was separately confirmed. The weekly integer-display rounding sensitivity is about 1.36974B~1.91764B/month (4 weeks), not a statistical confidence interval; the mid-to-end delta 12,201,679 tok/3pp maps to 1.62689B/month, kept only for comparison. The all-basis cache/input/output mix is about 95.1823%/3.4854%/1.3323%; the page's 96.5% is the input cache-hit rate, not the standard-workload cache share. Compared under identical workload and saturated use; it is not an official fixed token quota. Monthly regular price ¥49, recovered from the actual annual price ÷10 and the official FAQ, excluding the first-month promotion.; exchange rate 1 USD = 6.7787 CNY (2026-09-04 CNY central parity rate; old rate 7.2); CNY monthly fee divided by the rate to get USD; https://www.xinhuanet.com/20260904/4c1ce1cbf39d416997cb9c237d6f5024/c.html

entries.zh: 官方模型卡（MIT）第 3 节 Evaluation Results 表 DeepSWE v1.1 行：Pro 71.9 / Flash 67.9 / V2.5 Pro 19.0。同一模型的 DeepSWE 数字有三个互相矛盾的口径，按只记录不择一的规矩全部登记：①模型卡 71.9（本档采用，与 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 自报同为模型卡口径）；②官方发布页 mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/news/latest/v2-6 记 RL 曲线 58.4→72.6；③第三方 orcarouter 读小米 Live 面板终点 72.57（面板图注 mini-swe-agent, avg@3）。差异来自 checkpoint 选取、取整与 avg@k，②③未采用。官方榜无 MiMo 行。
entries.en: The official model card (MIT), section 3 Evaluation Results table, DeepSWE v1.1 row: Pro 71.9 / Flash 67.9 / V2.5 Pro 19.0. The same model has three mutually contradictory DeepSWE figures; per the record-all-choose-none rule all three are registered: ①the model card 71.9 (adopted for this tier — the same model-card basis as DeepSeek V4.1 Flash's self-report); ②the official release page mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/news/latest/v2-6 records an RL curve 58.4→72.6; ③the third-party orcarouter read the Xiaomi Live panel endpoint 72.57 (panel captioned mini-swe-agent, avg@3). The differences come from checkpoint selection, rounding and avg@k; ② and ③ were not adopted. The official board has no MiMo row.

entries.zh: 官方模型卡同表 Flash 行 67.9。同型矛盾口径：官方发布页记 RL 曲线 48.8→65.7、第三方读面板终点 65.68，均未采用（理由见 Pro 条）。这是 mimo-v2.6-flash 在本项目七张榜上的第一个分数——此前它 11 个采用点因无分数不进任何能力图。官方榜无 MiMo 行。
entries.en: The official model card's table lists the Flash row at 67.9. Conflicting same-model figures: the official release page records an RL curve 48.8→65.7 and a third party read the panel endpoint 65.68 — neither adopted (reasons in the Pro entry). This is mimo-v2.6-flash's first score on any of the project's seven boards — its previous 11 adopted points had no score and never entered a capability chart. The official board has no MiMo row.

entries.zh: 同表 MiMo-V2.5 Pro 列 19.0。注意这是厂商在展示新版提升时给出的上一代基准值，方向性偏低的动机存在，读者应按厂商自报折价；与该模型已有的官方榜读数（AA 智力 25.9869、Code Arena 1475、Agent Arena -3.57）量级不矛盾。小米未给 mimo-v2.5（非 Pro）的 DeepSWE 数字，故不补。
entries.en: The same table lists MiMo-V2.5 Pro at 19.0. Note that this is a previous-generation baseline the vendor quoted while showcasing the new version's improvement — a downward-bias incentive exists, so readers should discount it as a vendor self-report; it is not inconsistent in magnitude with the model's existing official-board readings (AA intelligence 25.9869, Code Arena 1475, Agent Arena -3.57). Xiaomi gave no DeepSWE number for mimo-v2.5 (non-Pro), so none is filled in.

entries.zh: xAI 发布页（2026-09-21）基准表 DeepSWE v1.1 行 71.0%*，星注 high effort。同表 Grok 4.6 High 65.2 与官方榜 mini-swe-agent - grok-4-6 (high) 65.188 差 0.012，据此判定同 harness 同口径。官方榜无 grok-4.7 行，该模型此前在 DeepSWE 榜缺位。同表 Terminal-Bench 4.0 自报 38.0% 不采用——该榜已有官方行 Grok Build - Grok 4.7 (xhigh) 37.6%，官方读数优先于厂商自报；同表 Grok 4.6 TB4 20.3 与官方榜 Grok Build - Grok 4.6 (high) 20.3 完全一致，进一步佐证两表同源。
entries.en: The xAI release page (2026-09-21) benchmark table's DeepSWE v1.1 row shows 71.0%*, footnoted as high effort. The same table's Grok 4.6 High 65.2 differs from the official board's mini-swe-agent - grok-4-6 (high) 65.188 by 0.012 — judged same harness, same basis. The official board has no grok-4.7 row; the model was previously absent from the DeepSWE board. The same table's self-reported Terminal-Bench 4.0 38.0% is not adopted — the board already has the official row Grok Build - Grok 4.7 (xhigh) 37.6%, and official readings take precedence over vendor self-reports; the same table's Grok 4.6 TB4 20.3 matches the official board's Grok Build - Grok 4.6 (high) 20.3 exactly, further corroborating that the two tables share a source.

entries.zh: AA 自家 harness 独立实测的 Terminal-Bench 4.0（models 榜载荷 terminalBench40 字段，fraction×100）；与 tbench.ai 官方榜分开计分。
entries.en: AA's own-harness independent measurement of Terminal-Bench 4.0 (the terminalBench40 field in the models-board payload, fraction×100); scored separately from the official tbench.ai board.

entries.zh: 厂商自报，非 tbench.ai 官方榜运行。Cognition 博客 Coding benchmark results 表 Terminal-Bench 4 列 27.3%。同表 Astra/Sol/Grok 4.6 与官方榜一致，Fable 5.1 55.8 与官方榜 57.88 不一致。无 CI、无成本/token 数据。见 devin-swe2-round1-2026-09-12.json。
entries.en: Vendor self-report, not an official tbench.ai leaderboard run. The Cognition blog's Coding benchmark results table lists Terminal-Bench 4 at 27.3%. The same table's Astra/Sol/Grok 4.6 agree with the official leaderboard; Fable 5.1's 55.8 does not match the official 57.88. No CI, no cost/token data. See devin-swe2-round1-2026-09-12.json.

entries.zh: 厂商自报，非 tbench.ai 官方榜运行。Anthropic 2026-09-22 Opus 5.5 发布页评测表 Terminal-Bench 4 行 66.4%（default effort）；同表 FrontierCode 54.4%、CursorBench 52.5%、GDPval-AA 1846 非本仓库榜单仅留证据；AA/arena/OpenDesign 暂无第三方快照分不补造。见 claude-opus55-round1-2026-09-23.json。
entries.en: Vendor self-report, not an official tbench.ai leaderboard run. The Anthropic 2026-09-22 Opus 5.5 release page's eval table shows Terminal-Bench 4 at 66.4% (default effort); the same table's FrontierCode 54.4%, CursorBench 52.5% and GDPval-AA 1846 are not this repository's boards — kept as evidence only; AA/arena/OpenDesign have no third-party snapshot score, so none is fabricated. See claude-opus55-round1-2026-09-23.json.
